metaphor: highway guide signs on a gantry over asphalt: the product is named for a direction, and its three verdicts are the sign colours every driver already knows
category_convention_avoided: logistics SaaS blue with a map tile and a truck icon; hackathon dark-mode console with an accent
design_code: Content sits on green sheet-metal sign panels with white Highway-Gothic-descended type, because the product is named for a highway direction and it is read the way a sign is read: fast, from a distance, by someone who has somewhere to be.

Verdicts are the road's own signs: a green guide panel with an arrow, a yellow warning diamond, a red regulatory prohibition, because MUTCD taught every driver on the judging panel what those three mean before they had a licence.
The canvas is asphalt and the section breaks are lane markings, because the sign is the figure and the road is the ground; a page that was all sign would be unreadable at speed.
Figures are tabular Overpass, because a column of lanes has to line up, and mono is barred as the personal fingerprint.
One motion only: a headlight sweep across a panel as it enters view, because retroreflective sheeting is the only way a sign has ever moved.
anti_brief: no map tiles, truck icons, or a semi at golden hour
no blue anywhere: it is the category convention and the consumed AI accent
no monospace as a design family; terminal captures are shown as screens, not set as type
no pill buttons, no card grid of round numbers, no blockquote-with-left-border
no glow: retroreflection is flat matte sheeting, not emission
expressive_axis: colour: the green field. Everything else is restrained.
structure: vertical stack of sign panels on a road; exit tabs carry section numbers

edge_depth.depth: hard offset shadow, 0 blur, sheet metal on a gantry

motion.signature: headlight sweep: a diagonal white band crosses a panel once when it enters the viewport, 700ms ease-out

ornament: highway arrow, exit tab, corner bolts, dashed lane divider, retroreflective bead texture at 4% on sign panels
